user.title: Connect Document Sender
user.description: Enter SMTP details. They are tested before anything is saved. Gmail uses smtp.gmail.com, port 587, and a Google App Password.

connection_actions.title: Test the SMTP connection
connection_actions.description: Use Test connection to verify the server and credentials before saving.

confirm.title: Connection verified
confirm.description: The SMTP connection and credentials were verified. Select Submit to save this configuration.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Document Sender
reconfigure.description: Connection details are tested before the integration reloads.

abort.already_configured: This sender email is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The default sender email cannot be changed during reconfiguration.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the SMTP server.
error.invalid_auth: The SMTP server rejected the username or password.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while testing the SMTP connection.

init.title: Document Sender options
init.description: Change delivery defaults and notification preferences. Use Reconfigure for SMTP credentials.

send.name: Send message
send.description: Send a plain-text or HTML email with optional attachments.
